review_title: Chemotherapy for advanced, recurrent or metastatic endometrial carcinoma
screening_criteria: RCTs comparing chemotherapy versus another intervention (including different chemotherapy) in advanced disease were considered. Trials of adjuvant treatment or for sarcomatous tumours were excluded.
gold_label_policy_description: dataset label 1.0 counts as INCLUDE; 0.5 and 0.0 count as EXCLUDE

studies.study_title: Revised FIGO staging for carcinoma of the endometrium
studies.predicted_reason: Not an RCT; this is a descriptive paper on FIGO staging classification for endometrial cancer with no comparison of chemotherapy interventions.

studies.study_title: A randomized comparison of doxorubicin alone versus doxorubicin plus cyclophosphamide in the management of advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma: a Gynecologic Oncology Group study
studies.predicted_reason: RCT comparing two chemotherapy regimens (doxorubicin alone vs doxorubicin+cyclophosphamide) in patients with advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma.

studies.study_title: Phase III randomised trial of doxorubicin + cisplatin versus doxorubicin + 24‐h paclitaxel + filgrastim in endometrial carcinoma: a Gynecologic Oncology Group study
studies.predicted_reason: Phase III RCT comparing two chemotherapy regimens (doxorubicin+cisplatin vs doxorubicin+paclitaxel+filgrastim) in advanced endometrial cancer.

studies.study_title: Reporting results of cancer treatment

studies.study_title: Treatment of recurrent adenocarcinoma of the endometrium with pelvic exenteration

studies.study_title: Comparison of adriamycin with cyclophosphamide in patients with advanced endometrial cancer
studies.predicted_reason: RCT comparing two chemotherapy agents (adriamycin vs cyclophosphamide) in patients with advanced endometrial cancer.

studies.predicted_reason: Randomized phase II trial comparing cisplatin alone vs CAP combination chemotherapy in progestin-refractory advanced endometrial carcinoma.

studies.study_title: Beta blockade during and after myocardial infarction: an overview of the randomized trials

studies.study_title: Extracting summary statistics to perform meta‐analyses of the published literature for survival endpoints
